title: Eusebius, Demonstratio Ecclesiastica (Lost)
english: I read Eusebius's Demonstratio Ecclesiastica in several books. This work has perished.

Codex 12 of 279; Eusebius's Demonstratio Ecclesiastica — lost work, known only from Photius's summary. Distinct from the partially extant Demonstratio Evangelica.
